sutta: now we come to another suta 3.13.129 monks there are these three things which are practiced in secret not openly what are they the ways of women folk are secret not open brahmins practice their mantras in secret not openly those of wrong or perverse views hold their view secretly not openly these are the three things monks there are these three things we shine forth for all to see which are not hidden what three the disk of the moon shines for all to see it is not hidden the disk of the sun does likewise the dhamma vinaya of the tata or the buddha shines for all to see it is not hidden these are the three things so in this suta the buddha said the most important thing here is that the dhamma vinaya that means the teachings of the buddha are not secret it's open for all to see and the dhamma vinaya dhamma is the sutas you'll find later under the chapter of the force and then the buddha said dhamma refers to the sutasla vinaya refers to the monastic and disciplinary corner for the monks and nuns so these dhamma vinaya are the complete teachings of the buddha the word tripitaka or tipitaka developed later after the buddha's time so here the buddha is saying and that the buddha's teachings are not secret there's nothing secret about the buddha's teachings it's only later that people practice secret teachings in the in in in so-called buddhism like even mantras mantras come from the brahmins did not come from the buddha according to our terravada teachings and so we have to be careful of any secret teachings anything that is secret is we have to be wary of it
